mechanisms.name: architectural_pattern_principle concepts
mechanisms.purpose: architecture as queryable data driving detectors
mechanisms.evidence: 8 principles minted 06-03, consumed by horizon detectors

principles: Validators must emit impulses, not just return HTTP errors — rejections must be observable to the authoring loop (concept-db-supersession proposal)
Soft supersession, never hard delete; supersession with a null target is the deprecation primitive; a second flag invites drift (concept-db-supersession)
Corrections/verdicts are first-class impulses, not string markup (concept-db-upkeep-loop §8)
Detector immunity pattern: inputShapes [], single resolver, no LLM, no pool iteration (06-01, 06-03)
Architecture as queryable data; detection as deterministic code over that data (pre-lift design.md)
A single LLM-capable dispatcher is a SPOF for self-modification; keep two architecturally different dispatchers (pre-lift)
No hard-coded category whitelists — relevance gates inclusion (drop-drafter-source-type-filter, concept_7mzv7SQN_7JB)
Don't invent new substrate tiers: restate every mechanism under impulse/activity/signature/Thompson/scope (concept_7mzv7SQN_7JB, LR-1..8)
Learning rate is sample-bound, not step-size-bound: levers are throughput, targeting, sample-need reduction (LR-acceleration proposal)
Reward information yield, not completion — completion saturates the selector (LR-acceleration Phase A)
Measure cyclic flow instead of ablating livelock (LR-acceleration Phase D)
'Substrate authored X' counts only with trace evidence of provenance + firing + emitted class (LR-acceleration)
A self-reported validity score is not evidence; resolvers compute, LLMs reason about metadata (merge-gate-computes-convergent-validity)
An external app that may be disconnected must not gate the self-development loop (non-obsidian-trace-pattern-feeder)
The author→exercise→promote loop must treat every system-authored activity identically, no prefix special-cases (system-authored-activity-promotion-loop)
Substrates share authored vocabularies, never posteriors (substrate-as-git-author)
Operator = novelty injection; substrate = instance authoring (LR-acceleration proposal)
